name: Implement zero-noise extrapolation by hand in Qiskit: estimate <ZZ> of a Bell ci
task_prompt: Implement zero-noise extrapolation by hand in Qiskit: estimate <ZZ> of a Bell circuit under depolarizing noise (p=0.066 on CX), amplify noise via global unitary folding (factors 1, 3, 5), fit a linear extrapolation to zero noise, and compare with the ideal value 1.0. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
